name: GAMCO Limited
about: GAMCO Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in financial investments, real estate, and warehousing infrastructure and hospitality sectors in India. The company is involved in structured financing, fixed-return portfolios, and secured lending; loans and advances; and shares and securities investments. It also engages in glass manufacturing operations. The company was formerly known as Visco Trade Associates Limited and changed its name to GAMCO Limited in December 2024. GAMCO Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
